api_base_url.label: Migu API service
api_base_url.description: Address of the local migu-api-enhanced service, including the /migu route prefix. Run it yourself; never sign in through a service you don't control.

auth_method.label: Sign in
auth_method.description: Sign in with an SMS code for VIP songs, lossless/hi-res audio and your playlists, or continue without an account (free songs at standard quality only).

options.sms: Sign in with an SMS code

phone.label: Phone number
phone.description: The mobile number of your Migu account. It is only passed to the Migu API service and not stored.

sms_code.label: SMS code
sms_code.description: Leave empty and submit to request a new code.

pacmtoken.label: pacmtoken
pacmtoken.description: Value of the pacmtoken cookie of a signed in music.migu.cn session.

audio_quality.label: Preferred audio quality
audio_quality.description: The best quality to request. When a song or your account does not offer it, the next lower one is used. Lossless and hi-res need a VIP account.

user.title: Connect Migu Music
user.description: Enter the address of your migu-api-enhanced service and choose how to connect.

phone.title: Sign in with SMS
phone.description: Enter your phone number to receive a login code. If Migu asks for an image captcha, sign in on music.migu.cn instead and use the pacmtoken option.

token.title: Paste a pacmtoken
token.description: Sign in on music.migu.cn in a browser, then copy the value of its pacmtoken cookie.

manifest.description: Stream the Migu Music (咪咕音乐) catalog through a local migu-api-enhanced service: search, albums, singers, playlists, charts and lyrics.
